{{Quote|This is ''Braxant Bonecrusher''. We have a hold full of people requiring urgent medical attention. Please advise.''"<br />"'' ''Bonecrusher'', this is ''Widowmaker''. You are instructed to dock with medical supply platform ''Hale Return''. Details to follow.|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and Captain Yage|<ref name="Heretic" />}}
The '''''Hale Return''''' was a medical supply [[Space station/Legends|platform]] used by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]<ref name="Heretic" /> that was positioned near [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|8|Hale Return}}</ref>&mdash;a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]<ref name="Region" />&mdash;during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> where the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were invading [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Heretic" /> In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> when the Remnant was [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|engaged]] with a Yuuzhan Vong [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Borosk system/Legends|Borosk system]], the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class cruiser]] ''[[Braxant Bonecrusher]]''&mdash;after having successfully rescued [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from a Yuuzhan Vong [[slaveship]] during the fighting&mdash;was directed to dock at the ''Hale Return'' by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arien Yage]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] so that the rescued prisoners could receive urgent medical attention.<ref name="Heretic" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Hale Return'' appeared in [[2003]]'s [[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant|''Force Heretic I: Remnant'']], a novel written by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]] as part of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series. It later got an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was published in [[2008]].
